zones: the selected card is otherwise authorized to be cast and is represented by a trusted face-pinned CardProgram
objects: phased-in permanents currently controlled by the caster whose effective card types include artifact
costs: each printed Affinity for artifacts instance reduces only the generic component of the spell's total cost by one for each qualifying artifact
the generic component cannot be reduced below zero
timing: the qualifying artifact count is evaluated while determining the spell's payable total cost
hidden_information: the spell remains visible only to seats legally entitled to see its origin zone until casting makes it public
the reduction reads only public battlefield characteristics
layers: artifact status comes from the canonical current effective-characteristic query
replacement_effects: cost-payment replacement effects are outside this bounded family and fail closed
copy: a copied spell was not cast and does not use Affinity
control_change: only artifacts currently controlled by the caster contribute
zone_change: only permanents currently present on the battlefield contribute
source_leaves: the spell's selected face and compiled descriptor are revalidated before payment

variants: multiple printed instances apply independently and cumulatively
Affinity parameters other than artifacts, dynamically granted or removed Affinity, and Affinity-equivalent rules text remain unsupported
